content.user_title: Design KPI Dashboards That Guide Decisions
content.value_statement: Teams often choose too many metrics or unclear layouts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create focused KPI dashboards with metric guidance and layout patterns.
actual_capabilities: Select KPI sets for sales, marketing, product, finance, and operations dashboards.
Structure executive summaries, SaaS metric dashboards, and real-time operations views.
Recommend dashboard hierarchy, alert placement, date filters, trends, and drilldown paths.
Explain SQL patterns for MRR, cohort retention, and customer acquisition cost.
Outline Streamlit and Plotly implementation patterns for dashboard prototypes.
limitations: It does not connect to live BI tools or databases by itself.
Example calculations must be adapted to real schemas, permissions, and data quality rules.
KPI definitions still need stakeholder approval and business context.
It does not replace analytics governance or production monitoring reviews.

use_cases.title: Build an executive KPI dashboard
use_cases.description: Create a one-page dashboard with headline metrics, trends, targets, and alerts.

use_cases.title: Plan a department analytics view
use_cases.description: Choose practical KPIs for sales, marketing, product, finance, or operations teams.

use_cases.title: Prototype a dashboard implementation
use_cases.description: Convert dashboard requirements into layout guidance and implementation notes for Streamlit or Plotly.

prompt_templates.title: Create a first KPI dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new dashboard structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a KPI dashboard for a [team or department]. Include 5 to 7 KPIs, layout sections, update frequency, and alert rules.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this dashboard outline: [paste outline]. Recommend better KPI grouping, clearer visualizations, and metrics to remove.

prompt_templates.title: Define SaaS metrics and calculations
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a SaaS metrics dashboard for [business model]. Include MRR, ARR, churn, retention, CAC, LTV, and calculation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Design an operational monitoring view
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a real-time operations dashboard for [service]. Include health signals, thresholds, alert severity, drilldowns, and incident review needs.

output_examples.input: Design a sales dashboard for a regional revenue team.
output: A dashboard outline with revenue, pipeline value, win rate, average deal size, and sales cycle length.
A layout that places headline KPIs first, followed by trend charts, pipeline views, and alerts.
Guidance for weekly manager review and monthly executive reporting.

output_examples.input: Improve a product analytics dashboard that has too many charts.
output: A reduced KPI set focused on active users, feature adoption, retention, satisfaction, and issue resolution.
Recommendations to remove vanity metrics and add trend context, targets, and drilldown paths.
A revised structure for product leadership and team-level investigation.

output_examples.input: Plan a Streamlit prototype for an executive KPI dashboard.
output: A prototype plan with date filters, KPI cards, trend charts, cohort retention, and alert sections.
Implementation notes for using Streamlit layout columns and Plotly charts.
Warnings to adapt sample data and calculations to real business definitions.

best_practices: Limit each dashboard to the few KPIs that directly support decisions.
Show context with targets, trends, comparisons, and documented calculation methods.
Match update frequency to the decision cycle for each audience.
anti_patterns: Do not fill dashboards with vanity metrics that do not change decisions.
Do not overcrowd layouts with charts that compete for attention.
Do not publish KPI dashboards without agreed definitions and data owners.

faq.question: Can this skill choose KPIs for different departments?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes KPI examples for sales, marketing, product, finance, and operations.

faq.question: Does it generate production-ready dashboard code?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and examples that need adaptation before production use.

faq.question: Can it help with executive dashboards?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes headline KPIs, trends, alerts, and one-page executive summaries.

faq.question: Does it support real-time monitoring design?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for service health, request throughput, error rates, and recent alerts.

faq.question: Can it define metric calculations?
faq.answer: It can outline calculation patterns for common metrics, but final definitions need business validation.

faq.question: Is this skill useful with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when planning dashboard layouts or prototypes.
